biggest_catch: You only get the $25 base bonus if your friend opens a checking account with a MyLine Line of Credit within 30 days of joining, and the extra $50/$100 only if they fund a direct auto loan or open a home equity product within the first 6 months. A friend who joins but skips the line of credit earns you nothing.
catches: Referral credit requires: referral joins via your unique link, opens checking with MyLine LOC within 30 days (for $25); auto loan funded or home equity product opened within 6 months (for $50/$100 extras).

INTERNAL PAGE INCONSISTENCY: the page's FAQ says 'up to $250 extra' per referral, but the detailed terms list $50 for an auto loan and $100 for a home equity product ($150 extra), and the worked example totals $175 per referral. We report the documented $175 per-referral maximum; do not expect $250 extra.
Limit $575 in referral credits per calendar year (and FAQ notes up to 10 successful referrals per year).
Bonuses deposited within 10 business days after each qualifying activity; accounts must remain open and in good standing until paid, otherwise forfeited.
Existing joint-owners on a Meriwest account are ineligible; consumer accounts only.
Meriwest employees, Board members, and their family members are ineligible.
Offer available as of 09/08/25 and subject to expire at any time.

Share the link with friends and family.
Friend joins Meriwest via your link and opens a checking account with a MyLine Line of Credit within 30 days of joining.

You earn $25 when they do this; plus $50 if they fund a direct auto loan and $100 if they open a home equity product within the first 6 months — up to $175 per referral, paid within 10 business days of each qualifying activity.
